# ObjectStorage v1

<!-- Generated by sdkgen; edit internal/cmd/sdkgen/service_docs.go. -->

Use Gophercloud v2.15.0's objectstorage/v1 API through one authenticated service object. Connection manages authentication, region, endpoint interface and TLS.

Service access: `conn.ObjectStorageV1(ctx)` (openstacksdk: `conn.object_store`).

Package docs describe the service, accounts, containers and objects (`go doc ./objectstorage/v1/...`). Guides: [accounts](accounts/README.md), [containers](containers/README.md), [objects](objects/README.md), [object creation](objects/create.md), [directory markers](objects/directory-marker.md), [reads](objects/read.md), [deletion](objects/delete.md), [waits](objects/wait.md), [capabilities](info.md), [signing](signing.md) and [temp URL keys](temp_url_key.md).

## Go usage

```go
// Inside a function with context.Context ctx and *openstack.Connection conn.
service, err := conn.ObjectStorageV1(ctx)
if err != nil { return err }
for value, err := range service.Containers.Resources.List(ctx) {
    if err != nil { return err }
    fmt.Println(value)
}
value, err := service.Containers.Find(ctx, resource.Name("example"))
if err != nil { return err }
_ = value
```

Examples use `fmt` and `github.com/JSYoo5B/go-openstacksdk/resource`.
